ABSENCE: `search_files` for `_leaked_scratch_projects`, `_PROJECT_KEY_PREFIX`, `RBJABCD`, and `ARBJ` returns matches ONLY inside conftest.py — no test file references the new symbol or the five cases the ticket comment claims were checked.

The live `jira-dc-harness` CI job (external-integration.yml:315) runs against a FRESH container with zero RBJ projects, so both the refusal branch and the fail-open branch are never executed even when the live suite runs; and tests/external/ is skipped without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 + a reachable instance (conftest.py opt-in guard).
A per-commit unit home already exists: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py enforces this harness's other live-independent invariants on every commit.
advisory.finding: The new residue discriminator `_leaked_scratch_projects()` and the fixture's raise-on-residue guard ship with no committed regression test, though the logic (RBJ-prefix filtering/sorting, fail-open on an unreadable list, and the RuntimeError on non-empty residue) is fully live-independent and unit-testable by monkeypatching the `_request` boundary. The ticket's change-1026 comment asserts five unit cases were checked (clean; single/multiple residue; lookalike keys `[RB, RBX, ARBJ1]`; 503 unreadable list), but none exist in the diff or the tree — a repo-wide search for `_leaked_scratch_projects`, `RBJABCD`, and `ARBJ` matches only conftest.py itself.
advisory.suggested_fix: In tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py (or a sibling unit module), import `_leaked_scratch_projects` and `_PROJECT_KEY_PREFIX` from the conftest module, monkeypatch its `_request` to return canned `(status, body)` pairs, and assert: `[{'key':'DEMO'},{'key':'TEST'}] -> []`; `[{'key':'RBJABCD'},{'key':'DEMO'}] -> ['RBJABCD']`; two RBJ keys -> the sorted pair; `[{'key':'RB'},{'key':'RBX'},{'key':'ARBJ1'}] -> []`; and `(503, None) -> []`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a unit case asserting `_leaked_scratch_projects()` returns `[]` when `_request` yields a non-200 status and when it yields a non-list body (fail-open, no invented residue).
evidence: tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py:172-175 `if status != 200 or not isinstance(body, list): ... return []`
ABSENCE: no test drives `_request` to a non-200 status or a non-list body, so the branch that prevents a transient error from blocking a clean run is never executed by any test.
wait_for_jira_dc_ready() (conftest.py:205) precedes the check, so by the time it runs the instance answers 200 — the live path structurally exercises only the success branch.
advisory.finding: The fail-open branch (`status != 200 or not isinstance(body, list): return []`) — the deliberate decision that a transient 5xx or malformed body must NOT invent residue and block a good run — is untested. This is a concrete error path the author flagged as one of 'the two ways this guard could have been worse than useless' (phantom residue making the harness flaky), yet no test pins it, and the live suite cannot exercise it because a healthy readied instance returns 200 + a list.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add cases to the suggested unit test: monkeypatch `_request` to return `(503, None)`, `(200, {"error": "x"})`, and `(200, "not-a-list")`, each asserting the result is `[]`.
